answer: One concrete defense is an ivory registry of attested agents: every participant holds a cipher certificate issued by an independent attester after a uniqueness proof, binding one agent to one real operator. Each economic action then costs a small ember of burnable compute, trivial for a single honest agent, but a sybil attacker fielding a thousand fake agents must pay the burn a thousand times for every coordinated move, plus the attestation cost of every certificate. Forgery thus carries a hard per-copy price instead of zero marginal cost, making large fake swarms uneconomical to run.
